brief.t: START HERE: Call Solabia and obtain confirmed stock and earliest ship dates for both the open 2 kg and 30 kg Estogel requests, then alert Sam today that the stated 10 to 12 week lead time may threaten the live Roon run.

ACT NOW 1: Estogel remains a live production risk. An update is due today, October 8, but is not late. Availability and shipment status for the 2 kg and 30 kg requests remain unverified, and the stated lead time is 10 to 12 weeks. The live Roon run may be exposed. Send: Please confirm stock and the earliest ship date for both the 2 kg and 30 kg quantities today, including whether either can ship immediately.

ACT NOW 2: Container EMCU8614105 was scheduled for pickup October 7. Demurrage was cleared and dispatchers were notified, but pickup, release, and ETA remain unverified. Aidan is 1 day past the scheduled pickup date. Send: Please confirm whether EMCU8614105 was released and picked up yesterday and provide its current ETA today.
